title: Mickey Mania: The Timeless Adventures of Mickey Mouse
description: Mickey Mania: The Timeless Adventures of Mickey Mouse is a 1994 platform video gamedeveloped by Traveller's Tales/Psygnosis and published by Sony Imagesoftfor the Super Nintendo Entertainment System, Sega Genesis, and Sega CD. In the game, the player controls Mickey Mouse, who must navigate through various side-scrolling levels, each designed and based from classical Mickey Mousecartoons. The game was later released on the PlayStation in 1996 as Mickey's Wild Adventure.
